items.name: Masterwork tool
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 77, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 50 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Category Tools
DescriptionThis tool is perfect for its intended job. It grants a +2 circumstance bonus on a related skill check (if any). The bonuses provided by multiple masterwork items do not stack.

 Several common items already count as masterwork tools for particular skills. These are the alchemist's lab, climber's kit, disguise kit, healer's kit, masterwork musical instrument, and masterwork thieves' to
